# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine years old (Volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c1 P31](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0031), [v4 c13 P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy and farm helper  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, chubby boy with a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his round head, roguish blue eyes, a snub nose, and a lopsided smile featuring a dimple in one cheek. He grows rapidly during his time at Green Gables, eventually losing a front tooth in his ninth year. Despite his frequent messiness from outdoor play, he is considered a very attractive child.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, highly inquisitive, and mischievous boy who is constantly driven by a desire to know why things are the way they are. Though frequently caught in antics, he is not malicious and possesses a warm, affectionate heart that craves love and approval. He can be defiant and stubborn, particularly towards strict authority figures, but he is easily swayed by kindness and candid explanations. Possessing a hearty appetite and a penchant for excitement, he is prone to impulsive misbehavior but experiences genuine remorse when he realizes he has pained those he cares about.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v3 c1 P47](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0047), [v3 c13 P9](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0009)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were born in East Grafton. After their father passed away in their infancy and their mother became terminally ill, they received little early upbringing. Upon Mrs. Keith's death, Marilla Cuthbert took the orphans into Green Gables. Davy quickly became infamous for his energetic pranks, such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, tricking Dora into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. Despite his wild behavior, he developed a deep attachment to Anne Shirley, who patiently guided his moral development and taught him the wrongness of lying. When his uncle Richard Keith died and left the twins a trust fund, Marilla and Anne were enabled to keep them permanently at Green Gables. Davy enrolled in Avonlea School, where he made friends with Milty Boulter and gradually learned to curb his worst impulses. Though he occasionally succumbed to temptation, such as playing hooky to go fishing with the Cotton boys, his penitence always brought him back to Anne's guidance. As he grew older, he developed an interest in farming, helped out around Green Gables, and declared his childhood affection for his classmate Stella Fletcher.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P27](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0027), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 c13 P33](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0033), [v3 c13 P93](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0093), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_
